thinking:
I'm checking a few ambiguous policy clauses against how the practice labeled them. A free-look refund within 30 days seems to have been tagged as term cancellation, and a similar insurer-initiated cancellation with pro rata premium return was tagged the same way, so both look consistent with that label. Next I'm wondering whether the clause about benefits ending at the maximum benefit period or recovery might instead belong under deductibles.

I'm now moving on to the conditions and duties section, and I'm still weighing whether the benefit-end clause should go under limits or coverage, with the option to drop it if the model disagrees.
